liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (3 reviews): Listener identifies Terrapin, Playin', and Wharf Rat as personal favorites in the recording; Listener finds the performance awkward, feeling Jerry was unsure what to sing next [5][12][13]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (2 reviews): Described as brilliant, upbeat, and loud, prompting the listener to slam their foot in rhythm; The performance is so inspired that the listener accepts the SSDD train wreck ending as fair penance [8][15]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Jerry's riff between the last two verses sounds like he is birthing Miracle [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-10-07.sbd-set2.miller.79020.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 10 songs; 87 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the Half-Step opener is fitting, though they wish to hear it one day [5]
- **gd1977-10-07.sbd-set2.miller.80753.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 87 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1977-10-07.170389.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 10 songs; 87 min [3]

## Around the show

- Lesh returned first from halftime, bouncing notes off the ceiling of the acoustically great pit [9]
- Listener speculates Ned Lagin may have joined Lesh, a detail impossible to capture in recordings [9]
- Listener compared this Sugar Magnolia to the Warfield concert on the same date, finding it creative [10]
- Listener hopes to hear if the first set matches the quality of the next night in Denver [11]
- Show is average until the last two songs, which are stunning versions of Wharf Rat and Sugar Mag [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-10-07.sbd-set2.miller.79020.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]
- **gd1977-10-07.sbd-set2.miller.80753.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: No first set AUD is known, and a partial second set circulated until 2008; Uploader fixed a dropout in Terrapin and a reel flip between Drums and Iko with a crossfade [2][11]
- **gd1977-10-07.170389.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  February 26, 2025; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [3]. Also: This source includes a fixed dropout in Sugar Magnolia and a fixed Terrapin dropout [3]
